verdict.rationale: The Marketing API documents an endpoint to "generate a new account export or download a finished account export" (mailchimp-docs-16), which suggests self-serve bulk export exists. The pack gives no detail on what the export contains, what format it uses, or whether it is available outside the API. Community complaints about deleted accounts concern lost access after deletion, not failure of the export feature, so they do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: confirmation that exports include custom fields, tags, engagement history and the suppression list; documentation of an open format such as CSV or JSON; a no-code UI export path; and independent or hands-on corroboration.
